Class GameGUI

java.lang.Object
Controller.GameGUI
public class GameGUI extends Object
Serves as the main orchestrator for "Yohane The Parhelion! The Siren in the Mirror World!". Holds all game state (player, dungeons, items, npcs) and exposes the operations the Swing UI (GUI.MainFrame and its panels) calls in response to user actions.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public static void initialize()
      Resets game state for a new game (or a New Game+ / respawn after death). Does NOT place the player on any dungeon floor - that only happens once the player actually picks a dungeon, via startDungeon().

    • startDungeon

      public static void startDungeon(Dungeon dungeon)
      Enters a dungeon for the first time: resets Yohane's turn counter so turn-interval effects (bat move cadence, the boss fight's every-8-turn bat summon) always start from a clean 0 rather than whatever parity was left over from the previous dungeon; sets the dungeon as current; places Yohane on its first floor; and clears the underlying 'Y' tile so it's not drawn twice. If the dungeon's first floor is the BossFloor, sets up the Siren fight instead (spawning Lailaps too and dealing out the first pair of switches).
      Parameters:
      dungeon - the Dungeon instance the player has chosen to enter

    • processTurn

      public static boolean processTurn(char input)
      Executes one turn: moves/uses an item per input, runs enemy AI, and advances to the next floor (or reports the dungeon as cleared) if the floor is complete.
      Parameters:
      input - the key pressed ('w'/'a'/'s'/'d' to move, ' ' to use item)
      Returns:
      true if the dungeon has just been fully cleared, false otherwise

    • getRescueDialogue

      public static String getRescueDialogue(String memberName)
      Retrieves the idol-specific rescue dialogue to show in the dungeon-cleared dialog box. Each idol's dialogue is keyed by name below; idols without a written scene yet return null, and the caller (GamePanel) simply omits that section of the dialog rather than showing anything.
      Parameters:
      memberName - the name of the idol who was just rescued
      Returns:
      the multi-line dialogue text for this idol, or null if none has been written yet

    • beginNewRun

      public static void beginNewRun()
      Call when the player has just chosen "New Game" / "New Game+" from the main menu. Resets game state and marks a run as in progress.

    • handleGameOver

      public static void handleGameOver()
      Call once, right after detecting Yohane.charDeath() (or Lailaps' during the boss fight), to record the game over and reset state for next time. Read any death info (HP, cause) from the player BEFORE calling this - initialize() replaces Yohane with a fresh PlayableChar.
